cases.prompt: Add tasteful animations to my landing page: the hero should fade in, and sections should appear as I scroll. It is plain HTML and CSS.
must_be_true: The agent inspects the existing CSS and scripts for current motion before adding anything
Only transform and opacity are animated
All movement is written inside a prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference block, or removed by a reduce block
The first screen is visible without JavaScript
Scroll reveals use IntersectionObserver or animation-timeline inside @supports, not a scroll event listener
The final report says what was and was not tested
must_not_happen: transition: all appears in the new CSS
A JavaScript animation library is added
Content stays hidden when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce
The report states frame rates or speed scores that were not measured

cases.prompt: My animations feel janky when I scroll, and the sidebar widens with a transition. Can you fix it?
must_be_true: The agent finds that width (a layout property) is animated and replaces it with transform or opacity, or explains the trade-off
The agent runs the bundled motion-lint script, or says it could not
Any remaining budget rule that is broken is named in the report with a reason
must_not_happen: The agent adds will-change to many elements as the fix
The agent claims the page is now faster without measuring it

cases.prompt: Make my site respect reduced-motion settings. It already has lots of animations that I do not want to rewrite right now.
must_be_true: The agent adds a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce safety-net block, or moves motion into no-preference blocks
The agent explains that the safety net also removes helpful fades and cannot stop script-driven animation
Smooth scrolling is disabled when reduced motion is requested
must_not_happen: The agent deletes all animations from the site
The agent says the site is fully accessible because of this one change

cases.prompt: Add a scrolling logo strip under the hero that moves on its own.
must_be_true: The agent adds a visible pause control, or explains why it is needed
The strip becomes a static or scrollable row when reduced motion is requested
The strip is the only endless animation on the page
must_not_happen: The strip runs with no way to pause it
The strip keeps moving when reduced motion is requested

cases.prompt: Build a product page with a 3D rotating sneaker that I can drag and zoom.
must_be_true: The agent does not apply the CSS motion workflow to the 3D model
The agent treats this as a 3D task, or says that a 3D skill or library is needed
must_not_happen: The agent fakes the 3D model with CSS transforms and calls it done

cases.prompt: Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to pin the hero and scrub a timeline while the user scrolls.
must_be_true: The agent does not apply this skill's CSS-only workflow
If the agent proceeds, it mentions the GSAP license before adding it
must_not_happen: The agent copies GSAP source files into the project without mentioning the license

cases.prompt: Change the headline on my homepage to 'Fresh coffee, delivered' and make the footer text smaller.
must_be_true: The agent makes only the requested text and style changes
must_not_happen: The agent adds animations or motion files to the project
